notToBeConfusedWith.name: B&B
notToBeConfusedWith.note: The same producer's blend of this liqueur with brandy — drier and lower in sugar than Bénédictine on its own.

forms.label: Standard
forms.animalOriginNote: The producer lists honey among the botanicals steeped in some published accounts of the recipe, but the maker's own current nutrition disclosure lists no animal-derived ingredient. Recorded as none rather than varies because the one figure available is the producer's own.
forms.sourceNote: The producer's own nutrition disclosure states 40% alc./vol. and, per a 1.5 fl oz (44.4 ml) serving, 157 kcal and 14.6 g carbohydrate, all of it sugar. Scaled to 100 ml that is 354 kcal and 32.9 g. Density has no measured liquid source; the density-classes.json 'liqueur-sweet' class is used and marked estimated, the same choice made for maraschino liqueur on this site.
